$comment: The inkcast mark, as numbers. This file is the record of the geometry across a
package boundary: apps/web draws it from the `MARK` const in
apps/web/components/marketing/logo.tsx, the favicon/apple-icon/OG rasters are cut
from it by ./make-brand-assets.mjs, and the video brand plate in packages/render
draws it into the last 1.2s of every film. Three consumers, two of which cannot
import a .tsx file, which is why the numbers live here as JSON as well.
make-brand-assets.mjs asserts that logo.tsx still contains the same path strings
and fails loudly if it does not, so the duplication cannot drift silently.
Coordinates are in a 32-unit box. See ./README.md for what the shapes mean and
docs/DESIGN.md for the tokens the colours come from.

roles.tile: fill: --card, stroke: --border (ink on paper, paper on ink)

$comment: The OKLCH values of the tokens the mark uses, copied from
apps/web/app/globals.css. The generator converts these to sRGB hex itself
rather than carrying hand-typed hexes: a favicon has no token layer, so the
assets must contain literal colours, but nobody should be typing them.
If a token moves in globals.css, move it here and re-run the generator.
